title: gadesrinam0-code/ai-rag-project
summary: 该AI驱动的检索增强生成（RAG）应用利用React、FastAPI、FAISS、Hugging Face Embeddings和Groq LLM构建。用户可以上传PDF文档并提问，以获得来自上传内容的上下文感知答案。该应用结合了模型推理、向量索引和分布式架构，适用于需要快速、准确内容检索和生成的场景。
description: An AI-powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application built with React, FastAPI, FAISS, Hugging Face Embeddings, and Groq LLM. Users can upload PDF documents and ask questions to receive context-aware answers from the uploaded content.
